Bug_Title: MS: May expose internal static state by storing a mutable object into a static field (EI_EXPOSE_STATIC_REP2)
Bug_Details:
This code stores a reference to an externally mutable object into a static
 field.
 If unchecked changes to
 the mutable object would compromise security or other
 important properties, you will need to do something different.
Storing a copy of the object is better approach in many situations.
Bug_Explanation: The static field staticList is being stored as a mutable object which can be changed by any method in the class. This can lead to unexpected behavior and potential security issues if the object is externally mutated.
Trigger_Explanation: The staticList is a shared resource among all instances of Main class. The test case modifies this list by calling the showBug() method. After this call, the size of the list is expected to be 2, because 'Hello' and 'World' are added, but the size is 1, because the 'World' string is added only once.
